title: A proof of Spence's formula using the reciprocity law for Dedekind sums
summary: In 1963, Edward Spence published a proof of the following With $φ$ being Euler totient function, if $n>1$ is an integer, and if \begin{equation*} 0<a_1<\cdots<a_{φ(n)}<n, \end{equation*} are the positive integers less than $n$, coprime with $n$, then \begin{equation*} \sum_{j=1}^{φ(n)}ja_j = \frac{φ(n)}{24}\left(8nφ(n)+6n+2φ(m)(-1)^{ω(m)}-2^{ω(m)}\right), \end{equation*} where $m$ is the square-free part of $n$ and $ω(m)$ is the number of prime factors of $m$. Spence's proof relies on an ingenious observation considering Nagell's totient function. Later in 1971, Lucien Van Hamme provided an…
